sourceRecords.title: Wales Grants Section 36 Consent to Llyr Floating Wind Project
sourceRecords.sourceText: OffshoreWIND.biz reported that the Welsh government granted Section 36 consent to the Llyr Wind Farm, a floating wind test and demonstration project in the Celtic Sea off Pembrokeshire. The source states that Llyr consists of two 100 MW wind farms, Llyr 1 and Llyr 2, and already had a marine licence from Natural Resources Wales.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.
